releases.notes:
## v1.2.0 (Minecraft 26.2 build)

This release contains the same features as v1.2.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2, recompiled and verified against Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2).

### Added
- `/backup next`: shows how much time is left until the next scheduled automatic backup (or that automatic backups are disabled).
- UUID support for `allowed-users`: the permission whitelist now accepts player UUIDs in addition to player names.

### Changed
- Automatic backups now run at a fixed daily time (`auto-backup-time`, e.g. `04:00`) instead of a repeating interval in minutes.
- No backup on startup: if the server starts after the configured time has already passed for the day, the automatic backup is skipped until the next day.

### Fixed
- Fixed the automatic backup unexpectedly triggering right when the server started.

### Notes
- Existing `simple-server-backups.properties` files from 1.1.0 will keep working; replace the old `auto-backup-interval-minutes` line with the new `auto-backup-time` option (e.g. `auto-backup-time=04:00`), or delete the file to regenerate it with the updated, fully commented template.

mods.description: Complete and secure backups for your server, using in-game commands, with permissions and automatic backups.

releases.notes:
## v1.2.0

### Added
- **Minecraft 26.2 support**: the mod has been recompiled and verified against Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2), in addition to the existing 26.1.2 build.
- **`/backup next`**: shows how much time is left until the next scheduled automatic backup (or that automatic backups are disabled).
- **UUID support for `allowed-users`**: the permission whitelist now accepts player UUIDs in addition to player names. UUIDs are recommended on premium (online-mode) servers, since they're tied to the real account and can't be impersonated, and they keep working even if the player changes their username.

### Changed
- **Automatic backups now run at a fixed daily time** (`auto-backup-time`, e.g. `04:00`) instead of a repeating interval in minutes. This makes scheduling predictable regardless of when the server was last restarted.
- **No backup on startup**: if the server starts after the configured time has already passed for the day, the automatic backup is skipped until the next day, instead of firing immediately on startup.

### Fixed
- Fixed the automatic backup unexpectedly triggering right when the server started, even when the scheduled time had nothing to do with the current moment.

### Notes
- Existing `simple-server-backups.properties` files from 1.1.0 will keep working; replace the old `auto-backup-interval-minutes` line with the new `auto-backup-time` option (e.g. `auto-backup-time=04:00`), or delete the file to regenerate it with the updated, fully commented template.
